newsitem.title: UK: Business travel to Eastern Europe up 23 percent.
newsitem.headline: Business travel to Eastern Europe up 23 percent.

text.p: UK business travel to Eastern Europe is at an all time high, with an increase in passenger figures of 23 percent in the last six months of 1996, according to figures from Lufthansa.

In response to extra demand, Lufthansa will introduce two new destinations from March 31, 1997 to its current Eastern European timetable -- Perm and Kazan in the Russian Federation. In addition, the airline has published the second Lufthansa Information Services Bulletin, a quarterly newsletter designed to offer UK business travellers practical advice on doing business in the emerging markets of Eastern Europe.

Frank Zehle, UK/Ireland passenger marketing manager said:"We are now publishing a regular Bulletin for business travellers with the aim of providing up to date information and advice on visiting any of the 19 Eastern European countries that Lufthansa flies to."
"If business travellers know what to expect at least they can prepare for their trip," Zehle added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
